subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a Drow who notices the Duergar's fixation on dragon scale color as a misconception, and recalls that the only dragons the Duergar know are the red dragons of the Keepers of the Flame, and Themberchaud is not doing dragonkind any favors.
source_quote: The Duergar of this city seem to live under the misconception that the color of a dragon’s scales has anything to do with its perspective and morality and choices. Although, to be fair, the only dragons they know are the red dragons of the Keepers of the Flame, and Themberchaud is not doing dragonkind any favors.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a cleric of Bahamut who performs the seventeen steps of the night prayer to the Platinum God with precision, and later tells Grogluk, 'Fuck those guys,' about the Ember Vanguard, then bribes him with 20 gold to pass through.
source_quote: Remembering a simple salute is no challenge for a cleric of Bahamut. The seventeen steps of the night prayer to the Platinum God are more challenging than this simple ritual. ... 'Fuck those guys,' I add with emphasis. ... I size him up and give him 20 gold.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a Drow wizard who uses his sphere of darkness to hide the group, and is confronted by Grogluk who demands proof he is not the Ember Vanguard, and notes that the golden dragonborne Zalthir is now red.
source_quote: Zalthir uses his sphere of darkness to hide the group. ... Grogluk chuckles at the thought, a gold dragonborne causing so much havoc. ... the golden dragonborne, Zalthir, is now red.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who accidentally unbuckles his belt and lets his pants fall during a bet, and later denies responsibility for the Ember Vanguard's actions, saying, 'We killed several members of the high council?'
source_quote: Thorin takes the bet and accidentally unbuckles his belt, and his pants fall. ... Thorin mutters, 'We killed several members of the high council?'

subject: Whorlstone caves
fact: The Whorlstone caves are exited by the group as they enter the slums of the Derro, and later the guardhouse there is abandoned, then not.
source_quote: we leave the Whorlstone caves and once again enter the slums of the Derro. ... When we came, this guardhouse was abandoned; now it’s not.

subject: Derro slums
fact: The Derro slums are a place where the people are on edge, and the atmosphere is charged with pre-revolutionary violence, and where posters of the Ember Vanguard are displayed with spelling and grammar mistakes.
source_quote: The Derro are particularly on edge. If I could express it, it would be a sense of pre-revolutionary violence. ... a poster that says, 'The Ember Vanguard, wanted dead as long as we can raise them or aliave.'

subject: West Cleft District
fact: The West Cleft District is entered after the Derro thin out, and contains a guardhouse now occupied, with a Duergar guard materializing and a poster of the Ember Vanguard on the wall.
source_quote: we find ourselves alone, some 50 feet from the entrance to the West Cleft District. ... a Duergar guard materializes and asks, 'Your business?' ... a poster that says, 'The Ember Vanguard, wanted dead as long as we can raise them or aliave.'

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a city of furnaces, bellowing heat, toxic fog, and haze that blocks out the light, and is contrasted with the beauty of Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Gracklstugh is a city of furnaces, bellowing heat, a toxic fog, and haze that blocks out the light. Visibility is constrained as we move about. The comparison with the filth of Gracklstugh and the beauty of Menzoberranzan is jarring.

subject: Laduguer’s Furrow
fact: Laduguer’s Furrow is where the richest and most powerful Duergar live, and is entered after passing through the slums and the gate.
source_quote: We stand in Laduguer’s Furrow. Here’s where the richest and most powerful of the Duergar live.

subject: Cairngorm’s Cavern
fact: Cairngorm’s Cavern is the home of a stone giant who refuses to reveal a route to the surface and closes his entrance for an unknown length of time.
source_quote: We end up at Hgraam’s cave ... The stone giant sighs. And he offers us a small pile of coins. And then asks us to leave, declaring that the entrance to his cavern would be closed for a while. ... As we leave Cairngorm’s Cavern...

subject: Gartokkar’s house
fact: Gartokkar’s house is where the group delivers the egg, and Gartokkar, a Duergar, becomes worried by the occult markings and asks Grygum, a cleric of Bahamut, for his opinion.
source_quote: We are soon at Gartokkar’s house. ... The Duergar takes the egg and notices the strange occult markings. He is worried. ... he turns to Grygum and asks him as a cleric of Bahamut, 'What do you think?'

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is the destination after the group escapes the Derro ambush and reads the note left by the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: As we walk through an alley, trying to be inconspicuous, a group of Derro surrounds us. ... As I pick through the coins in their pocket, I find a note. ... With this warning, we head out towards the Darklake.

subject: The Egg
fact: The Egg is a mysterious artifact rescued from a ritual, bearing strange occult markings, and is the object of a vendetta by the Gray Ghosts who believe it was stolen from them.
source_quote: We rescued it from a mysterious ritual. ... The Duergar takes the egg and notices the strange occult markings. ... The Egg. Your mission is clear: ... Recover The Egg. It belongs to the Gray Ghosts.

subject: The Ember Vanguard poster
fact: The Ember Vanguard poster is displayed in the West Cleft District with a spelling mistake ('aliave') and a grammar mistake, and depicts a drow wizard and a golden dragonborne who is now red, with a likeness of Thorin that is flattering and Grygum that is more fierce than he is.
source_quote: a poster that says, 'The Ember Vanguard, wanted dead as long as we can raise them or aliave.' ... The picture of the Ember Vanguard, most certainly, doesn’t look like us. The drow wizard is an ancient Drow wizard. The golden dragonborne, Zalthir, is now red. As for Thorin, the likeness is flattering. And as for Grygum, they made him far more fierce than he really is.

subject: The clenched fist pendant
fact: The clenched fist pendant is a crude token worn around Grogluk’s neck, a familiar symbol of the Underdark expressing loyalty to the ruler, and identifies him as working for the Deepking.
source_quote: around his neck is a crude pendant. ... It’s a familiar token of the Underdark, a clenched fist that expresses loyalty to the ruler. ... 'This Duergar works for the Deepking.'

subject: The Stone Guard passes
fact: The Stone Guard passes are documents shown to Grogluk to prove legitimacy, but he dismisses them as forgeable and demands proof that the group is not the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: I show him the passes of the Stone Guard. ... Grogluk stares at them, annoyed, 'Passes can be forged. Show me proof that you are not the Ember Vanguard!'

subject: The Gray Ghosts note
fact: The Gray Ghosts note is a written vendetta found on a dead Derro, ordering the stalking, shadow-striking, and paranoia-inducing pursuit of the Ember Vanguard to recover The Egg, and declares failure is not an option.
source_quote: To all - ... The Deepking’s agents—the four shadows, The Ember Vanguard, who walk among us, wielding dark magic and unmatched skill—have brought death and dishonor to our kin. ... Your mission is clear: ... Stalk them relentlessly. ... Strike from the shadows. ... Leave paranoia in their wake. ... Recover The Egg. ... Failure is not an option. Be swallowed by the shadows, or make them so.

subject: Derro
fact: The Derro are a people on edge, with pre-revolutionary violence in their atmosphere, and are the victims of the Ember Vanguard who killed several members of their High Council, leading to a vendetta by the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: The Derro are particularly on edge. ... since the Ember Vanguard killed several members of the Derro High Council. ... The Gray Ghosts will have their revenge for the murder of the High Council.

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar are a people who live under the misconception that dragon scale color determines morality, are ruled by the Deepking, and enforce strict identity checks at gates, demanding bribes and proof of innocence.
source_quote: The Duergar of this city seem to live under the misconception that the color of a dragon’s scales has anything to do with its perspective and morality and choices. ... 'This Duergar works for the Deepking.' ... He looks me over and tells us that the Stone Guard is on edge ... demands a gold piece

subject: Gray Ghosts
fact: The Gray Ghosts are a secretive faction of Derro who seek vengeance for the murder of their leader and the theft of The Egg, and operate through shadow, paranoia, and relentless stalking.
source_quote: The Gray Ghosts will have their revenge for the murder of the High Council. ... Your mission is clear: ... Stalk them relentlessly. ... Strike from the shadows. ... Leave paranoia in their wake. ... Recover The Egg. It belongs to the Gray Ghosts.

subject: Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard are feared shadowy assassins from Menzoberranzan, believed to wield dark magic and blades that rend souls, and are wrongly accused by the Derro of killing their High Council and stealing The Egg.
source_quote: They are not mere adventurers, more like shadowy assassins from Menzoberranzan with powerful magic and blades that can rend souls. ... The Deepking’s agents—the four shadows, The Ember Vanguard, who walk among us, wielding dark magic and unmatched skill—have brought death and dishonor to our kin.

subject: Bribery of Grogluk
fact: Grygum bribes Grogluk with 20 gold after performing the ritual and declaring 'Fuck those guys,' causing Grogluk to shout that the group may pass through.
source_quote: I size him up and give him 20 gold. He smiles and shouts to the others here that we are to pass through.

subject: Thorin's pants fall
fact: Thorin accidentally unbuckles his belt during a bet, causing his pants to fall, and the group laughs, improving their mood.
source_quote: Thorin takes the bet and accidentally unbuckles his belt, and his pants fall. We all laugh. ... Our mood is better, so we decide to visit the giants.

subject: Confrontation at Gartokkar’s house
fact: Gartokkar accepts the Egg, becomes worried by its markings, asks Grygum for his opinion as a cleric of Bahamut, and then gives the group a bag of coins after agreeing to a deal and non-disclosure.
source_quote: The Duergar takes the egg and notices the strange occult markings. He is worried. ... he turns to Grygum and asks him as a cleric of Bahamut, 'What do you think?' ... He smiles at me and says, 'A deal and a non-disclosure agreement is a deal.' ... comes back with a bag full of coins.

subject: Ambush by Derro and discovery of the Gray Ghosts note
fact: A group of Derro surrounds the party, refuses to listen to their denials, and is killed; a note found on their bodies declares a vendetta against the Ember Vanguard and orders the recovery of The Egg.
source_quote: a group of Derro surrounds us. They announce that the Grey Ghosts will have their revenge for the murder of the High Council. ... A few moments later, there are five dead Derro. ... As I pick through the coins in their pocket, I find a note. ... 'Recover The Egg. It belongs to the Gray Ghosts.'

subject: Grogluk's identity challenge
fact: Grogluk scrutinizes the party and declares, 'You are a Drow,' then 'You are a dwarf and you are an orc!' and later demands proof they are not the Ember Vanguard, then asks for a bribe.
source_quote: The guard scrutinizes me, and the rest of our group, and declares, smugly, 'You are a Drow.' Turning to Thorin, then Grygum he says, 'You are a dwarf and you are an orc!' ... 'Show me proof that you are not the Ember Vanguard!' ... 'But I do have some guards, and it would be a shame if I could not spread some coin.'

subject: Grogluk's final refusal and demand
fact: Grogluk, after being shown the Stone Guard passes, demands the group lay down their weapons and magic items or speak the secret message of the Stone Guard.
source_quote: Grogluk stares at them, annoyed, 'Passes can be forged. Show me proof that you are not the Ember Vanguard! ... If you are innocent, lay down your weapons and magic items for inspection or speak the secret message of the stone guard.'

subject: Grogluk
fact: Grogluk is a 4-foot-tall Duergar with ashen grey skin, scars, tattoos, and a clenched fist pendant, who pretends to be alone but is surrounded by invisible guards, and works for the Deepking.
source_quote: Grogluk is about 4 feet tall; he has the typical ashen grey skin of the duergar. His face has scars and a few tattoos. ... around his neck is a crude pendant. ... 'This Duergar works for the Deepking.' ... Grygum whispers to me, 'There are at least five more invisible guards we can’t see in this hallway.'

subject: Duergar guard at West Cleft District
fact: The Duergar guard at the West Cleft District materializes and asks 'Your business?' and stands before a poster of the Ember Vanguard with spelling and grammar errors.
source_quote: a Duergar guard materializes and asks, 'Your business?' ... a poster that says, 'The Ember Vanguard, wanted dead as long as we can raise them or aliave.'

subject: Gray Ghosts
fact: The Gray Ghosts are a hidden faction of Derro who stalk the Ember Vanguard, use invisibility and illusions, and seek to recover The Egg by any means, including death.
source_quote: The Gray Ghosts will have their revenge for the murder of the High Council. ... Your mission is clear: ... Stalk them relentlessly. ... Strike from the shadows. ... Leave paranoia in their wake. ... Recover The Egg. It belongs to the Gray Ghosts.

subject: The misconception of dragon scale color
fact: The thread of misunderstanding that dragon scale color determines morality is repeated by Duergar, Daz, and Grogluk, and is contrasted with Zalthir's knowledge that Themberchaud is not doing dragonkind any favors.
source_quote: The Duergar of this city seem to live under the misconception that the color of a dragon’s scales has anything to do with its perspective and morality and choices. ... Grogluk chuckles at the thought, a gold dragonborne causing so much havoc. ... Themberchaud is not doing dragonkind any favors.

subject: The false identity of the Ember Vanguard
fact: The thread of mistaken identity runs through the narrative: the group is accused of being the Ember Vanguard, though they are not, and the poster misrepresents them with a red Zalthir and a more fierce Grygum.
source_quote: The picture of the Ember Vanguard, most certainly, doesn’t look like us. ... The Deepking’s agents—the four shadows, The Ember Vanguard, who walk among us ... have brought death and dishonor to our kin. ... 'We killed several members of the high council?'

subject: The fragility of peace in Gracklstugh
fact: The thread of deteriorating peace runs from the Derro on edge, to the High Council murdered, to the Gray Ghosts seeking vengeance, to the Stone Guard on edge, and to Grogluk warning of explosion.
source_quote: The atmosphere at the gate has put me on edge. The balance that kept the peace is tilting towards madness. ... since the Ember Vanguard killed several members of the Derro High Council. ... Everyone is worried something is going to happen, and some want it.

subject: The use of bribes to navigate authority
fact: The thread of bribery runs through encounters with Duergar guards: Daz pays a guard, Grygum pays Grogluk, and the pattern suggests corruption is systemic in Gracklstugh’s gatekeeping.
source_quote: He looks me over and tells us that the Stone Guard is on edge ... demands a gold piece, and we pay him off. ... I size him up and give him 20 gold. ... 'But I do have some guards, and it would be a shame if I could not spread some coin.'

subject: The contrast between Menzoberranzan and Gracklstugh
fact: The thread of aesthetic contrast runs from Daz’s observation that the Drow would not reduce suffering but would at least have clean air, to the jarring filth of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The comparison with the filth of Gracklstugh and the beauty of Menzoberranzan is jarring. ... The Drow would not reduce the suffering in this place, but at least it would have clean air.

subject: The illusion of control by the Deepking
fact: The thread of false control runs through Grogluk’s act of solitary authority, the invisible guards, the posturing, and the realization that he is not alone but pretending to be.
source_quote: Grogluk’s defiant and proud demeanor is an act. He’s not alone. He just pretends to be. ... There are at least five more invisible guards we can’t see in this hallway.

subject: The ambiguity of the Egg’s origin
fact: The thread of ambiguity surrounds the Egg: it was rescued from a ritual, marked with occult symbols, desired by the Gray Ghosts, and feared by Gartokkar, yet its true nature remains unknown.
source_quote: We rescued it from a mysterious ritual. ... The Duergar takes the egg and notices the strange occult markings. He is worried. ... 'Recover The Egg. It belongs to the Gray Ghosts.'

subject: The failure of communication between factions
fact: The thread of failed communication runs from the Derro refusing to listen to the group’s denials, to Grogluk dismissing the Stone Guard passes, to Gartokkar accepting the deal without understanding it.
source_quote: The Derro won’t listen. ... 'Passes can be forged.' ... 'I don’t know what kind of deal we made or who we made it with!'

subject: The role of humor in tense situations
fact: The thread of humor runs from Thorin’s pants falling, to Jimjar’s bet, to Grygum’s 'Fuck those guys,' suggesting that levity is used to manage fear and cohesion in the party.
source_quote: Thorin takes the bet and accidentally unbuckles his belt, and his pants fall. We all laugh. ... Jimjar smiles as if the goal wasn’t to win or lose the bet but something else, to change our mood. ... 'Fuck those guys,' I add with emphasis.

subject: The myth of the Ember Vanguard as a symbol
fact: The thread of myth-making runs through the poster, the note, the accusations, and the fear: the Ember Vanguard is a phantom, a scapegoat, a symbol of chaos that unites the Derro in vengeance.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard, wanted dead as long as we can raise them or aliave. ... The Deepking’s agents—the four shadows, The Ember Vanguard, who walk among us ... have brought death and dishonor to our kin. ... 'Who are these fearsome warriors, the Ember Vanguard?'
